post.yt_title: Noah's Flood: Why Would a Loving God Do That? 🌊 #shorts
post.yt_desc:
"A loving God flooded the whole world? How is that love?" Fair question. The earth "was filled with violence" (Genesis 6:11), and "every intent of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually" (Genesis 6:5). Yet "the Divine longsuffering waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was being prepared" (1 Peter 3:20).

And God still gives one way in. Jesus said: "I am the door. If anyone enters by Me, he will be saved…" (John 10:9)

📖 Read it yourself: Genesis 6–9, 1 Peter 3:20, 2 Peter 3:9 (NKJV)

What question should we answer next? Tell us below 👇

post.notes:
- 'Full of violence': Genesis 6:11 "the earth was filled with violence."
- Genesis 6:5 NKJV quoted from "every intent…" (verse begins "Then the LORD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that…").
- 1 Peter 3:20 NKJV quoted from "the Divine longsuffering…" (verse begins "who formerly were disobedient, when once" and continues ", in which a few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.").
- John 10:9 NKJV quoted to "saved" (continues ", and will go in and out and find pasture.").
- 'God still gives one way in': John 10:9, John 14:6; the ark as a picture of salvation: 1 Peter 3:20–21. Storm scene = ship in storm (no people drowning shown).
